title: Embeddings + Rerank: scratchnotes (dim mismatch + latency)
content:
Context:
- Noticed intermittent 500s from /rerank endpoint and several customer reports of missing results.
- Two visible symptoms: (A) dimension mismatch errors in service logs, (B) large p95/p99 latency spikes (1000-3000ms) on rerank path starting ~2026-02-19 22:10 UTC.

Initial error snippets (from rerank-service logs):
- 2026-02-19T22:11:03Z ERROR rerank.handler ValueError: Embedding dim mismatch: expected=1024 got=1536 (traceback below)
- 2026-02-19T22:11:03Z WARN rerank.pipeline skipping item id=usr_1243 due to embedding shape mismatch
- 2026-02-19T22:12:45Z ERROR rerank.handler TimeoutError: Reranker invocation exceeded 2500ms

Commands / quick repros I ran:
1) Quick curl to rerank API (local dev):
   curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.dev/rerank" -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"how to reset password","docs":[{"id":"d1","embedding":[...]}]}'
   -> reproduced 500 with same ValueError (embedding dim mismatch).

2) Pull embeddings for a failing user from pg (psql):
   SELECT id, model, embedding_dim, embedding_model_version FROM embeddings WHERE user_id='usr_1243' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
   -> rows show mixture: model="open-embed-1024-v1" dim=1024 and some older rows model="open-embed-1536-v2" dim=1536.

3) Recreate feed pipeline locally to simulate:
   # python snippet
   from embedder import load_embedding
   e = load_embedding('open-embed-1024-v1')
   e_vec = e.encode('query')
   # call reranker expecting 1024 -> raise when doc vectors are 1536

Observations / hypotheses:
- Hypothesis A: Mixed-model embeddings in DB (1536 vs 1024) cause reranker (which expects 1024) to crash. Why mixed? Potential causes:
  * A migration to a new default embedding model was rolled out but not normalized for existing vectors.
  * Multiple ingestion pipelines/staging jobs write to the same table with different default model params.
  * Cache layer returned embeddings from a different model (bad cache key: omitted model_version).

- Hypothesis B: Latency spikes correlate with large batch loads when fallback to CPU-based distance computation happens (e.g., caches miss or GPU pool saturated). When vectors require on-the-fly up/down-projection or conversion, CPU path is slow.

What I checked so far:
- Checked model catalog config: hosted-api/embeddings defaults changed on 2026-02-18 03:20 UTC (see GH PR gh:repo/embed-config#67 authored by @lina). That PR introduced "open-embed-1536-v2" as an alias for new higher-dim vectors for some tenants.
- Audit of ingestion job logs (s3://ingest-logs/2026-02-18/) shows a batch ingestion that used model=open-embed-1536-v2 for tenant=internal. Some customer pipelines likely used new default without writing model_version metadata to DB.
- Sample of DB rows lacking embedding_model_version (NULL) -> these defaulted to legacy assumption of 1024 in rerank service. Hence mismatch on read.

Immediate remediation ideas (fast):
1) Hotfix rerank service to validate dims and gracefully skip mismatched vectors (must log tenant+doc id + model suspicion). Avoid 500s.
2) Add a compatibility layer: if embedding_dim==1536 and reranker expects 1024, either refuse but return 200 with partial results or run a fallback projection (if conservative and available).
3) Quick DB cleanup: find recent rows with embedding_model_version NULL and infer model by vector length and backfill embedding_model_version and embedding_dim. Run on staging first.

Longer-term fixes:
- Enforce embedding_model_version non-null at write-time (schema + ingestion validation).
- Strengthen ingest pipeline to include model_version in cache keys and DB writes.
- Add monitoring alert for "mixed embedding dims" per-tenant and per-index (count distinct dims >1 -> alert).
- Update rollout playbook: when changing default embedding model, run a migration to re-embed critical indexes or mark affected tenants.

Repro step for cleanup script (psuedo):
- Run in dry-run mode first:
  python tools/identify-mixed-dims.py --tenant <tenant_id> --dry-run --limit 1000
- Backfill (example):
  python tools/backfill-embedding-metadata.py --tenant <tenant_id> --infer-by-length --confirm

Logs to attach (copied to /tmp/):
- /tmp/err-2026-02-19-rerank.log (snippets above)
- /tmp/ingest-audit-2026-02-18.log

Open TODOs:
- [ ] Run dry-run of identify-mixed-dims for top 10 affected tenants (priority order).
- [ ] Coordinate with Lina to see if gh:repo/embed-config#67 rollout included any canary flags.
- [ ] Implement hotfix in rerank to avoid 500s (PR queued: gh:repo/re-ranker#228).
- [ ] Validate CPU fallback path performance and add capacity if needed (SRE/infra).

Notes for on-call handoff:
- If seeing ValueError: embedding dim mismatch -> set incident tag "embed-dim-mismatch" and run identify script for tenant. If many tenants affected, escalate to EngLead (Aran).
- For latency spikes: check GPU pool saturation (monitoring: infra/gpu-pool/p95) and rerank CPU queue length (infra metrics).

Contact list:
- Aran Singh (eng-serving-runtime) - assigned to hotfix
- Lina Gomez (applied-ml) - owns embedding model rollout config

Recorded at: 2026-02-20 09:30 PST
